occupation_rle.csv.recipe: Filter Element Name == 'Required Level of Education'; rle_mean = weighted mean of Category with Data Value weights, per O*NET-SOC Code (replicates onet.education.rle_by_occupation)

occupation_cluster_intensity.csv.recipe: Per occupation, mean raw descriptor 'value' within each capability cluster S1/S2/A1/A2; clusters from gradient_compass_clusters_membership (cluster_rank 1/2, prefix S=skills, A=abilities). Replicates Paper 1 notebook 5, cell 18.

occupation_skills_levels.csv.recipe: Pivot of the Skills overlay long export to a wide occupation x descriptor matrix of raw levels ('value'); one row per onet_code, one column per descriptor.

occupation_abilities_levels.csv.recipe: Pivot of the Abilities overlay long export to a wide occupation x descriptor matrix of raw levels ('value'); one row per onet_code, one column per descriptor.

onet_task_exposure.csv.source: Eloundou, Manning, Mishkin & Rock (2024), "GPTs are GPTs: Labor market impact potential of LLMs", Science 384(6702):1306-1308
onet_task_exposure.csv.measure: phi = beta = E1 + 0.5*E2 (continuous LLM exposure in [0,1])
onet_task_exposure.csv.recipe: Read full_labelset.tsv, select column 'beta', one row per O*NET Task ID; written by scripts/07_build_exposure.py. Joined to the geometry on numeric Task ID downstream (17549/17606 tasks, 99.7%).

national_M2019_dl.xlsx.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2019 national estimates
national_M2019_dl.xlsx.note: Origin year for the centroid-shift test (script 11). Header row uses LOWERCASE column names (occ_code, o_group, h_median) unlike the 2024/2025 vintages; normalise on read. 789 detailed SOC, 723 with numeric H_MEDIAN.

national_M2024_dl.xlsx.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2024 national estimates
national_M2024_dl.xlsx.note: Robustness vintage. UPPERCASE headers. 831 detailed SOC, 755 with numeric H_MEDIAN; 695 detailed SOC carry numeric H_MEDIAN in both 2019 and 2024.

national_M2025_dl.xlsx.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2025 national estimates
national_M2025_dl.xlsx.note: Primary endpoint for the 2019->2025 centroid-shift test (latest available vintage). UPPERCASE headers. 830 detailed SOC, 772 with numeric H_MEDIAN; 695 detailed SOC carry numeric H_MEDIAN in both 2019 and 2025.
